//*************************************************
// The view returns all software components with ABAP language version "ABAP for SAP Cloud Platform" and
// HOME/LOCAL/CUSTOMER which might not have ABAP LANGUAGE VERSION 5 if they are not excluded via config
// In SAP Cloud Platform ABAP environment, this applies to all the software components created by a customer.
// In OnPrem environment, this applies to all the software components with ALV = 5 + Type C + HOME + LOCAL
//
// Element Definition:
// - SOFTWARE_COMPONENT: Software component name w/o installed components and local components
//*************************************************
@Metadata.ignorePropagatedAnnotations: true
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_ALLOWED
@EndUserText.label: 'Value Help Software Components SCP'
define view entity ARS_SOFTWARE_COMPONENTS_SCP_VH
  as select from ARS_SOFTWARE_COMPONENTS_SCP
{
  key  software_component
}
where
      is_local_software_component <> 'X'
  and is_installed_component      <> 'X'
  
union select from ARS_SWC_CUST_SNAPSHOT_RELEVANT
{
  key  software_component
}
